format: TypeScript (TSX with React and Remix framework)
description: This file defines the main route component for a simple notes application using Remix. It includes server-side loaders and actions for managing notes (create, update, delete), and a React component that renders the layout with sidebar and main content area. It also handles client-side interactions such as creating new notes.

methods.name: loader
methods.description: Loads initial data, currently returning a placeholder indicating success. Notes are hydrated client-side from local storage.

methods.name: action
methods.description: Handles form submissions for creating, updating, deleting, or starting a new note. Performs server-side operations and redirects or responds with JSON accordingly.

methods.name: Index
methods.description: React component rendering the main layout with sidebar and main content, handling interactions like creating new notes and displaying placeholders when no note is selected.

methods.name: handleNew
methods.description: Client-side callback to create a new note and navigate to its route.
